description: Read one owned My business meeting: title, schedule, current status, settings and its guestUrl/hostJoinUrl. When asked for joining links, always include both, clearly labelled Link for your guest and Join as host in the user’s language. Resolve the roomId with list_meetings first. Does not join the room or generate participant credentials. Read only.

locale.description: Language for errors. Meeting branding and default room language come from the account. Use the conversation language.

roomId.description: The exact roomId returned by list_meetings or create_meeting. Never guess an ID.

name: get_meeting
